finding: CortexSelectAvenue already used supplied threat belief position, not a live target transform. Its any-hit FIRE/GEOM and VIEW/GEOM exposure score could count humans as screening, and fixed2m source offset could overshoot close endpoints.
implementation: Use existing CortexCoverScreened for cover and concealment samples. Optional source-object second ray exclusion preserves avenue source hull ignore; existing consumers keep objNull default. Shared predicate excludes human surfaces, caps4 results and clamps offset to half segment. Concealment uses shared VIEW/NONE policy rather than material GEOM fallback.
authority: Read-only scoring; same maximum8 candidates, existing route legs/three exposure samples per leg, terrain/firelane rejection and selected-route executor. No target-position query, state, worker, movement or deadline.
cost: At most same2object rays per exposed sample, result cap1to4. Concealment may add one terrain test after failed cover; helper validation/arithmetic added per sample. Runtime and5/10budget unmeasured.
limits: Four human hits can hide a later solid surface, conservatively withholding score. No continuous path/cover guarantee; physical tactical route quality unverified.
validation: Existing609 source-contract checks adapted to shared query owner; full build result in handover.
